# DevPod (Loft)

Dimension: DevPod (loft-sh/devpod) as a self-hosted Kubernetes workspace tool.

## Architecture (decision-critical)

DevPod is explicitly **"Client-only … No need to install a server backend, DevPod
runs solely on your computer"** [15]. It is a desktop app + CLI that provisions
workspaces through providers; the docs describe no browser web portal for managing
workspaces [15]. Browser IDE access (openvscode-server) exists *inside* a running
workspace, but workspace **creation/lifecycle still requires the local desktop app or
CLI** — which violates the hard browser-only-lifecycle constraint.

The browser management portal is **DevPod Pro**, a separate paid enterprise control
plane [17] (Snippet). So the only browser-only path is paywalled.

## Maintenance risk

Issue #1915 (Sep 11 2025): "I've seen no changes nor releases in the past months. Is
this project still maintained…?" — labeled stale [16]. Loft Labs rebranded to vCluster
Labs (Aug 2025) and refocused away from DevPod [18] (Snippet). A community fork was
reported by discovery agents but not confirmed in the fetched issue body.

## Verdict

Disqualified on the browser-only-lifecycle hard constraint (OSS is a desktop launcher;
browser portal is paid) and weakened further by stalled maintenance.
